name: Three staggered perforated plates
source_prompt: Candidate reconstruction from the single uploaded isometric reference: three parallel upright plates, the center plate set back from the two outer plates, and three vertical holes on each plate in large-small-large order. Image proportions only; dimensions are nominal estimates.

length.evidence: Single isometric image: plate face-width/height ratio; nominal plate height normalized to 100 mm.

width.evidence: Single isometric image: visible plate side-wall thickness relative to face width.

height.evidence: Single isometric image: reference-height normalization, not a drawing dimension.

center.note: Left plate occupies X=0..40, Y=-4..4, Z=0..100 in the chosen global frame.

length.evidence: Single isometric image: outer plate face-width/height ratio, using the same scale as the left plate.

width.evidence: Single isometric image: same nominal side-wall thickness as the left plate.

height.evidence: Single isometric image: same full-height extent as the left plate.

center.note: Right plate is shifted along X with a 10 mm physical gap to the recessed center plate; Y and Z match the left plate.

length.evidence: Single isometric image: assumed same face width as the two outer plates.

width.evidence: Single isometric image: assumed same plate thickness as the outer plates.

height.evidence: Single isometric image: assumed same bottom and top level as the outer plates.

center.note: X=70 mm is midway between outer centers X=20 and X=120; Y=-13 mm places this plate behind both outer plates because the local iso renderer sees +Y; the 10 mm X gaps keep through-hole cutters local to each plate.

features.name: Inferred top bridge
features.note: Image shows a continuous upper mass; represented as a simple bridging block to connect the three plates.

length.evidence: Single isometric image: long-to-short top-face edge ratio after accounting for the local isometric renderer projection.

width.evidence: Single isometric image: short top-face edge relative to the long edge, fitted to the same projection.

height.evidence: Single isometric image: estimated thickness of the upper connecting mass.

center.note: Placed behind the front faces at center Y=-18 with width 49 (bounds Y=-42.5..6.5), and overlaps the upper ends of all three plates.

diameter.evidence: Single isometric image: turquoise opening width is about 0.36 of the plate face width.

point.note: Hole lies on the left plate centerline X=20, center plane Y=0, at the upper row Z=78.

diameter.evidence: Single isometric image: blue middle opening is visibly smaller, about 0.22 of the plate face width.

point.note: Hole lies on the left plate centerline X=20, center plane Y=0, at the middle row Z=50.

diameter.evidence: Single isometric image: lower turquoise opening matches the upper large opening.

point.note: Hole lies on the left plate centerline X=20, center plane Y=0, at the lower row Z=22.

diameter.evidence: Single isometric image: lower center opening follows the upper large diameter.
